data.summary: “Bro Got Ragebaited 😂” has pulled 11,655,917 views at ~203,250/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a POV/skit whose strongest lever is payoff pacing. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: A tight, fast cold-open with the payoff up front likely sustains the watch-through that Shorts distribution favors.
A high-contrast thumbnail with a clear focal subject likely lifts the initial tap rate against a busy Shorts feed.
An unusually high like-to-view ratio suggests strong resonance, a signal the algorithm likely reads as a reason to keep distributing it.
The setup withholds the resolution, likely driving rewatches and completion — both strong short-form ranking signals.

outlier_insight.headline: **4.4× their own median** — **emotion** is what broke the pattern.
outlier_insight.pattern_break: Their other clips top out near **6.5M** (e.g. “He Shouldn’t Have Trusted Him 😂 #funny #hopecore”); this one **4.4×'d** their median. The break: it leans harder on **emotion** than their usual pov/skit uploads.
outlier_insight.why_it_spread: Spread via **shareability** — people tag a friend in the comments.
outlier_insight.steal_this: **Lead with the emotional spike** (surprise / awe) — that's the share trigger.
outlier_insight.replicability_note: the relatable bit is the engine, and you can run it on a new situation.
